metadata.description: Jody's portable pro dev skill stack

plugins.name: pro-core
plugins.description: Core dev skills: brainstorming, TDD, debug, planning, worktrees, subagent-driven dev, grill-me (interview-driven plan stress-test). /gh universal GitHub workflow command (briefing, new, commit, push, pr, ship, sync, resolve). PreToolUse hook blocks dangerous Bash (force-push to main, rm -rf /, .env redirects, sudo, chmod 777, curl|bash). SessionStart hook nudges parallel subagent dispatch.

plugins.name: pro-quality
plugins.description: Quality gate skills: requesting + receiving code review, verification-before-completion. Depends on Playwright from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js stack marker with official Vercel and Figma plugin dependencies

plugins.name: pro-design
plugins.description: Frontend design skills: design tokens, accessibility audit (WCAG 2.2 POUR), motion system, typography scale, shadcn/ui composition. Depends on Figma from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-testing
plugins.description: Testing skills: Vitest, Playwright automation, Storybook interactions, visual testing. Depends on Playwright from claude-plugins-official

plugins.name: pro-data
plugins.description: Data & auth skills: Drizzle ORM (architecture + schema), Prisma schema patterns, NextAuth/Auth.js patterns

plugins.name: pro-spec
plugins.description: Spec-driven development skills: writing feature specs (PRDs with Given/When/Then), clarifying specs (10-category ambiguity taxonomy). Adapted from github/spec-kit

plugins.name: pro-spdd
plugins.description: Structured Prompt-Driven Development workflow: story decomposition, analysis, REASONS Canvas, generation, prompt update, sync, API test, code review, and reverse engineering. Adapted from gszhangwei/open-spdd.

plugins.name: pro-gstack
plugins.description: Opt-in GStack workflow adapters: persona-driven planning, review, QA, shipping, browser, security, documentation, and memory workflows. Adapted from garrytan/gstack.

plugins.name: pro-mieruka
plugins.description: Mieruka integration: /init-mieruka installs mieruka into the current project, /start-mieruka launches the dev server. Resolves local build until mieruka is published to npm.

plugins.name: pro-starter
plugins.description: Meta-plugin: installs Jody's full pro dev stack (6 skill-bearing plugins plus pro-nextjs marker and pro-mieruka)
